nowyRelaks.label: Property developer
nowyRelaks.title: Nowy Relaks — Filipek Investment
nowyRelaks.teaser: A single-family home developer near Biała Podlaska traded a free template for a site built from scratch — with a full presentation of the development and an inquiry form going straight to the sales team.
nowyRelaks.description: Nowy Relaks is a single-family home development near Biała Podlaska, run by developer Filipek Investment. The company previously used a free template that neither built trust nor presented the offer the way the development deserved. We designed and built the site from scratch, with a full presentation of the location, construction stages, and interior galleries. We added a simple form for enquiring about specific homes, delivered straight to the sales team. Result: a more modern brand image and more purchase inquiries.

gdyniaPadelClub.label: Sports club
gdyniaPadelClub.title: Gdynia Padel Club
gdyniaPadelClub.teaser: A sports club in Gdynia got a dynamic online booking system integrated with court availability — less administrative work, an easier booking path for players.
gdyniaPadelClub.description: Gdynia Padel Club is a sports club in Gdynia. We built them a site showcasing their courts and full class schedule. The key challenge was letting customers book a court quickly without calling the front desk. We implemented a dynamic online booking system, integrated with real-time court availability. The site also presents pricing, events, and the club's social media in one place. Result: less administrative work for the team and an easier booking path for players.

creoGedania.label: Private education
creoGedania.title: Creo Gedania — 10 new students from two reels
creoGedania.teaser: Micro-influencer marketing and precise Meta Ads + TikTok Ads: two reels with a local creator generated over 50,000 targeted views and 10 new school enrollments.
creoGedania.description: Ahead of Open Days, private school Creo Gedania needed to precisely reach parents across the Tri-City area. We wrote a script for a shoot with micro-influencer @poznajtrojmiasto and backed the material with targeted Meta Ads and TikTok Ads campaigns. Result: over 50,000 targeted views and 10 new students enrolled straight after watching the material.
